Here is some tips to cusomize this project!

Making a level:

1. Remix this project
2. Make a level
3. follow the other tips!

Difficulty Customization:

Click on the Difficulty face to customize it!

Custom Song:

1. Import a song to Stage
2. Delete the "Custom Song" Sound (second last sound in stage)
3. go to "Buttons" Sprite
4. Select 56th costume
5. Edit the text after your song!

Level naming:

1. Go to "Buttons Sprite"
2. Go to Costumes
3. Select the first cosume
4. Edit the Text
